sn34.13:1.4: samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave
sn34.13:1.5: ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo. idha pana
sn34.13:1.6: bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo. idha pana
sn34.13:1.7: bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo ca. tatra
